answer: Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zenith re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
